description: This file defines a thread-safe weak pointer implementation in C++, including classes for weak references, weak pointer factories, and support for weak pointers in objects. It provides mechanisms for safe object referencing across threads with invalidation and lifecycle management.

classes.name: WeakReference
classes.description: Represents a weak reference to an object, with thread-safe invalidation.

classes.name: WeakReferenceOwner
classes.description: Manages ownership of WeakReference objects, allowing invalidation of all associated weak references.

classes.name: WeakPtrBase
classes.description: Base class providing core weak pointer functionality, including reset and internal reference management.

classes.name: WeakPtr
classes.description: Template class representing a weak pointer to an object of type T, supporting safe access and validity checks.

classes.name: WeakPtrFactory
classes.description: Creates and manages weak pointers to an object, allowing invalidation of all weak pointers.

classes.name: SupportsWeakPtr
classes.description: Mixin class that enables an object to produce weak pointers to itself.

methods.name: WeakPtr<T>::get
methods.description: Returns a raw pointer to the object if valid, otherwise nullptr.

methods.name: WeakPtr<T>::operator bool
methods.description: Checks if the weak pointer is valid.

methods.name: WeakPtrFactory<T>::GetWeakPtr
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the associated object.

methods.name: WeakPtrFactory<T>::InvalidateWeakPtrs
methods.description: Invalidates all weak pointers created by this factory.

methods.name: SupportsWeakPtr<T>::AsWeakPtr
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the object.
